projects.name: Asir Leaf
projects.description: Collected and labelled 6,400 coffee-plant leaf photos with farmers' cooperatives and an agronomist; cleaned and balanced the dataset via filtering and augmentation; fine-tuned a pretrained image classification model using PyTorch; evaluated using a held-out farm's data with precision, recall and confusion matrix per disease; tuned 24 hyperparameter combinations; compressed the model for fast offline inference on a mid-range Android phone; deployed an app used by eleven farmers for a month; achieved 93% test accuracy across five disease classes.

projects.name: Used-car prices
projects.description: Predicted asking prices from 18,000 Saudi classified adverts by comparing linear regression, random forest and gradient boosting models; the gradient boosting model achieved an average error of 9%.
